body:
Review findings addressed (pushed to `issue/225-spindle-edit`, head `40fd7ba`).

1. **Merge conflict with main.** Merged main at `06a194c` (`adb9a7f`). That is main just before #277, so this push changes nothing under `.github/`. `egui_app/tests.rs` keeps all three `mod` lines (`spindle_row`, `stock_size`, `stock_fit_sides`). The `RECOMMENDED.md` entry moved verbatim to `docs/decisions/225-spindle-edit.md` (the per-PR decisions rule), and `RECOMMENDED.md` is main's again. `git merge-tree` of the new head with current `origin/main` is clean.
2. **Wrong status for a zero diameter** (`spindle_row.rs`). Surface mode with a zero or non-finite tool diameter now says `spindle speed not changed: tool diameter must be above zero to show or set surface speed`. A zero or negative speed still says `it must be above zero`. The logic lives in a new pure helper, `refusal()`. Pinned by `egui_app::spindle_row::tests::a_zero_diameter_is_named_as_the_cause_in_surface_mode`.
3. **Optional: machine limit.** The row's hover now names the machine's `spindle_max` when one is stated. A committed speed above that maximum is held to it, with the status note `spindle speed N rpm held to the machine's maximum M`. This is the same hold `cutting::compute` applies to a suggestion. The machine check still refuses any over-limit speed. Pinned by `egui_app::spindle_row::tests::a_speed_over_the_machine_maximum_is_held_to_it`.

**Tests.** Run on a throwaway merge of the new head with current `origin/main`, from `crates/ui`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast`: all green. lib 275 passed / 2 ignored (all 5 spindle tests included), boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, edge_loop_pick 2, egui_app 3, feedback 6, fixtures 7, gpu_render 9, machine 6, models 4, operations 31, shell 19, theme_files 14, trace_composite 4, trace_parity 5. Snapshots match; none were regenerated.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Overlap with other open PRs** (`git merge-tree`):
- No conflict with #252.
- With #188, one extra small conflict in `crates/ui/src/state.rs`, in the `State` initializer: `spindle_as_vc: false` next to `debug_info_open` / `gpu_line`. Keep both.
- #213 and #222 conflict only where they already conflict with main.

Re-tested after #222 merged: `git merge-tree` of head `40fd7ba` with `origin/main` `f7deca0` is clean. On a throwaway merge with it, `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --no-fail-fast` (from `crates/ui`) is all green: 17 binaries, lib 275 passed / 2 ignored, all 5 spindle tests included. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean. GitHub reports MERGEABLE.

<!-- review-cost: estimated -->
**Estimated agent cost:** ~$0.54 (rough estimate from size: 230 changed lines)

No token usage was recorded for this PR, so this is calibrated from PRs with measured cost (our fix PRs, fix agent + review: median ~$1.20, ~$2.33 per 1,000 changed lines; floor $0.15, cap ~$3.60). For a contributor's PR it estimates what writing and reviewing it the way our agents work would cost, not what their session actually spent.

Blended upper estimate: 90 % input / 10 % output at list price (Opus 5.5 ~$5.60/M, Sonnet 5.5 ~$2.80/M, Haiku 5.5 ~$0.14/M). Cache reads make the real cost lower; main-session coordination isn't counted.
